home.heroLead: You send us your name, logo and photos. We write the words, design and build the site, set it up for Google, and launch it in about three weeks.
home.aboutTeaser: {name} is a small web studio for small businesses. We have built sites for cafés, hospitals, colleges, shops, homestays and trekking agencies. Scroll down to see some of them.

about.headline: Websites done for you, start to finish
story: Most small business owners don't have time to learn website builders, write their own copy, or figure out Google. That is our job. You tell us about your business, and we handle the rest.

Every site follows the same proven process: a short intake form, a plan, copywriting, design and build, SEO basics, your review, and launch. You see and approve everything before it goes live, and the site stays yours, built on WordPress so anyone can edit it.
about.mission: Give every small business a website that looks professional and brings in customers.
about.values: Fixed prices agreed up front, plain language instead of jargon, and websites you own and can edit yourself.
about.experience: Sites built for restaurants, hospitals, colleges, schools, clothing brands, online stores, homestays, trekking agencies, gyms, law firms and real estate agents.

services.intro: Three packages with fixed prices, plus an optional care plan. Domain and hosting are billed separately at cost.

items.name: Starter website
items.summary: From {starter}. A one-page website with everything a small business needs on a single scrolling page.
items.details: Your story, services, photos, contact details, a Google Map, WhatsApp and call buttons, and a contact form, all on one fast page. Includes copywriting, SEO basics and one revision round.

items.name: Standard website
items.summary: From {standard}. Five pages: Home, About, Services, Contact and an optional Blog. Our most popular package.
items.details: A full business website with a page for each service area, written for your customers and set up for Google. Includes copywriting, SEO basics, a contact form, two revision rounds and a short training video.

items.name: Plus website
items.summary: From {plus}. Up to eight pages for businesses with more to show, plus an extra revision round.
items.details: For hospitals, colleges, hotels and businesses with many services or locations. Everything in Standard, with up to eight pages and three revision rounds.

items.name: Care plan
items.summary: {care} a month. Updates, backups, security checks and small text changes.
items.details: We keep WordPress and plugins up to date, take regular backups, check for security problems, and make small text or photo changes for you each month. Optional, and you can cancel any time.

contact.intro: Tell us about your business and the kind of website you need. We will reply with a fixed quote, usually within one working day.
